blocks.label: Start with the coverage you have
blocks.text: The kind of insurance, current employment and employer size can matter to enrollment timing.

blocks.label: COBRA has different timing rules
blocks.text: COBRA is not coverage based on current employment and does not extend the time to enroll in Part B.

blocks.label: Signing up and coverage starting are different
blocks.text: For most people first eligible at 65, the initial sign-up window spans seven months. Coverage start also depends on when and how enrollment happens; first-of-month birthdays have special rules.

blocks.label: Confirm the actual start
blocks.text: A birthday or preferred start is not an actual Medicare effective date. Social Security confirms the enrollment route and effective date.

coverage_paths.title: How coverage fits together
dependencies: exact products, period and geography for personal findings

blocks.label: Original Medicare
blocks.text: Parts A and B through the federal program.

blocks.label: Medicare Advantage
blocks.text: Parts A and B through a Medicare-approved private plan.

blocks.label: Optional additions
blocks.text: Separate Part D for drugs; Medigap may help with your share of costs.

blocks.label: Drug coverage
blocks.text: Most Medicare Advantage plans include Part D. Check the exact plan.

blocks.label: Where Medigap belongs
blocks.text: Medigap works with Original Medicare, not Medicare Advantage. Drug coverage is separate.

blocks.label: Access to care
blocks.text: You can use a U.S. doctor who takes Medicare.

blocks.label: Access and rules
blocks.text: Doctors, costs and rules vary by plan and need checking.

blocks.label: Part B premium
blocks.text: The Part B premium still applies with either coverage route.

blocks.label: Future flexibility
blocks.text: Medigap buying rights need a separate check. The federal six-month period depends on both age and Part B enrollment; other conditions and rights may matter.

blocks.label: Each month
blocks.text: Premiums pay for coverage. A premium alone is not your total cost.

blocks.label: When you use care
blocks.text: Deductibles, copays and coinsurance depend on the benefit's rules.

blocks.label: What a limit covers
blocks.text: A Medicare Advantage limit applies to covered medical cost sharing. Premiums and drug costs are separate.

blocks.label: Original Medicare on its own
blocks.text: Parts A and B have no yearly medical spending cap on their own.
